name: 考研英语
description: 考研英语入学考试词汇（来源：english-wordlists/NPEE_Wordlist.txt，约 5400 词），按 COCA 词频排序

words.meaning: art.这(那)个;这(那)些(指特定的人或物)
words.example: Please would you pass the salt.  请你把盐递给我。

words.meaning: v.(就)是,等于;(存)在;到达,来到,发生
words.example: He is rich.  他很富有。

words.meaning: conj.和,与,而且;那么;接连,又
words.example: We were wet and tired.  我们浑身湿透，精疲力竭。

words.meaning: prep.…的;在…之中;用…制的;关于…的
words.example: I've never been north of Edinburgh.  我从未去过爱丁堡以北的地方。UK preposition

words.meaning: art.一(个);每一(个);(同类事物中)任一个
words.example: I've bought a car.  我买了辆汽车。

words.meaning: prep.在…里(内,上);用…(表示)ad.进,入
words.example: Put the milk back in the fridge when you've finished with it.  喝完牛奶后把它放回冰箱。

words.meaning: prep.(表示方向)到;向;(表示间接关系)给.
words.example: She agreed to help.  她答应帮忙。

words.meaning: v.有,具有;体会,经受;从事;使;吃,喝
words.example: I've heard that story before.  我以前听过那个故事。

words.meaning: pron.它;[作无人称动词的主语]
words.example: The company was losing money and it had to make people redundant.  该公司在亏损，所以不得不裁员。

words.meaning: pron.(主格)我
words.example: Am I invited?  邀请我了吗？

words.meaning: a./pron.那,那个 ad.那么 conj.[引导从句]
words.example: I've never liked that cousin of hers.  我从来没喜欢过她的那个表亲。

words.meaning: prep.为了;给;代替;向;支持 conj.因为?
words.example: There's a phone message for you.  你有一个电话留言。

words.meaning: pron.你;你们;一个人,任何人
words.example: You look nice.  你看起来不错。

words.meaning: pron.他;(不论性别的)一个人
words.example: Don't ask Andrew, he won't know.  不要问安德鲁，他不会知道的。

words.meaning: prep.跟…一起;用;具有;关于;因;随着
words.example: He lives with his grandmother.  他和奶奶一起生活。

words.meaning: a.连接上 prep.在…上;靠近 ad.向前,继续
words.example: Look at all the books on your desk!  看看你书桌上这么多书！

words.meaning: aux.v. vt.做,干,办,从事;引起 vi.行动
words.example: That was a really stupid thing to do.  那么做真是太愚蠢了。

words.meaning: vt.说,讲;说明;比如说 vi.说,发表意见
words.example: Small children find it difficult to say long words.  小孩子觉得长字不好说。

words.meaning: pron.这(个) a.这(个);今 ad.这(样)
words.example: Can you sign this form here for me?  请你在这表上签个名好吗？

words.meaning: 商店。(一般人经常用复数they来指一家商店)
words.example: I've known the Browns for a long time. They're very pleasant people.  我认识布朗一家已经很久了。他们都很友善。

words.meaning: prep.[表示价格、速度等]以,达;在..方面
words.example: We'll meet you at the entrance.  我们会在入口跟你碰头。

words.meaning: conj.但是 prep.除...以外 ad.只,才,仅仅
words.example: She's very hard-working but not very imaginative.  她工作很努力，但缺乏想像力。

words.meaning: pron.我们<主格>
words.example: Can we all go to the swimming pool this afternoon?  我们今天下午能都去游泳吗？

words.meaning: pron.[he的所有格/物主代词]他的(所有物)
words.example: Mark just phoned to say he'd left his coat behind. Do you know if this is his?  马克刚才打电话来说他的外套丢了。你知道这件是不是他的？

words.meaning: prep.从,自从;由于;离;根据,按;去除
words.example: What time does the flight from Amsterdam arrive?  从阿姆斯特丹飞来的航班甚么时候到达？

words.meaning: ad.不,不是,不会;没有
words.example: He's not fat!  他不胖！

words.meaning: prep.被;凭借;经由;由于ad.在近旁;经过
words.example: The motorcycle was driven by a tiny bald man.  一个秃顶的小个子男人驾驶着那辆摩托车。

words.meaning: pron.(主格)她

words.meaning: conj.或,或者(表示选择);即,大约;否则

words.meaning: ad.同样地 conj.由于;像...一样 prep.作为

words.meaning: pron.什么 a.多么,何等;什么;尽可能多的
words.example: What time is it?  几点了？

words.meaning: v.去,离开;走;放置;变成;运转 n.围棋
words.example: We went into the house.  我们走进了那座房子。

words.meaning: pron..[they的所有格]他(她、它)们的
words.example: He gave them their coats.  他把他们的外衣交给了他们。

words.meaning: aux.v.能;可以 n.罐头;容器 vt.把…装罐
words.example: You'll need a can of tuna for this recipe.  做这道菜需要一罐鲔鱼。

words.meaning: pron.谁,什么人;…的人;他,她,他们
words.example: Who did this?  这是谁做的？

words.meaning: v.获得,得到;使,使得;变得,成为;到达
words.example: He's gone down to the corner shop to get some milk.  他到那家街角小店买牛奶去了。

words.meaning: conj.(用于连接宾语从句)是否;是不是
words.example: I'll pay you double if you get the work finished by Friday.  如果你周五前完工，我付你双倍的报酬。

words.meaning: aux./v.将;可能;将会;总是,总会;宁愿
words.example: He said he would see his brother tomorrow.  他说明天要去见他的兄弟。

words.meaning: pron.[she的宾格]她;[she的所有格]她的
words.example: If your sister's around, bring her too.  如果你姐姐在，带她一起来。

words.meaning: a.全部的;非常的 ad.完全地,很 pron.全部
words.example: All animals have to eat in order to live.  所有动物都必须吃东西才能生存。

words.meaning: pron.(I的所有格)我的
words.example: It wasn't my fault.  这不是我的错。

words.meaning: n.(产品)来源,制法 vt.制造,做成,准备
words.example: Shall I make some coffee?  我煮些咖啡好吗？

words.meaning: ad.在周围;大约 prep.关于;在周围 a.准备
words.example: What's that book about?  这本书是关于甚么的？

words.meaning: vt.知道,了解;认识;识别 vi.知道,了解
words.example: She knows the name of every kid in the school.  她知道学校里每个孩子的名字。

words.meaning: aux./v. 将;会;愿意 n.意志;决心;愿望
words.example: Clare will be five years old next month.  下个月克莱尔就五岁了。

words.meaning: ad.向上,...起来;...完;起床 prep.向上
words.example: Put those books up on the top shelf.  把那些书放到书架顶层。

words.meaning: num.一 pron.一个(只)(表示代替可数的东西)
words.example: You've got three bags and I've only got one.  你有3个袋子，我只有1个。

words.meaning: n.时间,时刻;次,回;时代,时期;倍,乘
words.example: He wants to spend more time with his family.  他想多花时间陪家人。

words.meaning: ad.在那儿;往那儿;[作引导词表示""存在""]
words.example: Put the chair there.  把椅子放在那里。

words.meaning: n.年,年度,学年 a./ad.每年,一年一次
words.example: Annette worked in Italy for two years.  安妮特在义大利工作了两年。

words.meaning: ad.那么;非常;也;不错 conj.因此;以便
words.example: The house is so beautiful.  这房子太漂亮了！

words.meaning: v.想,思索;认为,以为;想要;料想,预料
words.example: What did you think of the film?  你觉得这部电影怎么样？

words.meaning: ad./pron.何时;当时 conj.那时;然后;而
words.example: When are you going?  你甚么时候走？

words.meaning: a./pron.哪个,哪些;什么样的;那个,那些

words.meaning: pron.他们/她们/它们(they的宾格形式)
words.example: I've lost my keys. I can't find them anywhere.  我丢了锁匙，到处都找不着。

words.meaning: a.几个;一些;有些;某(人或物) pron.一些
words.example: There's some cake in the kitchen if you'd like it.  想吃蛋糕的话，厨房有一些。

words.meaning: pron.[I 的宾格]我
words.example: Is there one for me?  有我的一份吗？

words.meaning: n.人们,人;[the-]人民;一国人民,民族
words.example: Many people never take any exercise.  许多人从来不做任何运动。

words.meaning: v.拿取;吃;记录;取得;花费;捕获;认为
words.example: Has anything been taken (= stolen) ?  丢了甚么东西吗？

words.meaning: ad.出去;离家;突出来 a.外面的,往外去的
words.example: She opened the window and stuck her head out.  她打开窗户，将头探了出去。

words.meaning: prep.到...里面,进入;成为(表示变化)
words.example: Would you put the jar back into the cupboard for me, please?  请帮我把罐子放回碗橱里，好吗？

words.meaning: ad.正好地;刚才;只不过 a.公正的,公平的
words.example: I'll just finish this, then we can go.  我马上就做完了，然后我们就能走了。

words.meaning: vt.看见;会面;探望;知道,获悉;送行
words.example: Turn the light on so I can see.  打开灯，这样我才看得到。

words.meaning: pron.他(he的宾格形式)
words.example: If you see Kevin give him my love.  如果你见到凯文，替我向他问好。

words.meaning: pron.[you的所有格]你的,你们的

words.meaning: v.来;出现于,产生;是,成为;开始,终于
words.example: Are you coming with me?  你跟我来吗？

words.meaning: v.aux.(口语)(表示许可或请求)可以...,行
words.example: When I was younger I could stay up all night and not get tired.  我年轻时，一通宵不睡觉都不觉得累。

words.meaning: v.喜欢 prep.象;比如 a.相象的 n.象…一样
words.example: Do you like fish?  你爱吃鱼吗？

words.meaning: a.另外的,其他的 n./pron.另一个人(或事)

words.meaning: ad.1.(表示方法、手段、状态)怎样;如何
words.example: How do we get to the town from here?  我们怎么从这里去城里？

words.meaning: ad.当时,在那时;然后,于是;那么,因而

words.meaning: pron.[it的所有格]它的
words.example: The dog hurt its paw.  狗的爪子受伤了。

words.meaning: pron.[we的所有格]我们的
words.example: We bought our house several years ago.  我们的房子是几年前买的。

words.meaning: num.二,两个n.两个(人或物)
words.example: They've got two houses.  他们有两幢房子。

words.meaning: a.更多的 n.更多的人(或东西) ad.更,更多

words.meaning: pron.&a.[this的复数]这些;这些人(东西)
vt.想要;希望;需要;缺,缺少 n.需要;短缺

words.meaning: n.道路,路程;方法/式,手段;习惯;状态
words.example: Do you know the way to the train station?  你知道去火车站怎么走吗？

words.meaning: ad.而且(也),此外(还);同样地

words.meaning: ad.不是,不 a.没有的;不允许 n.不,拒绝

words.meaning: ad.在(到,向)这里;这时;在这一点上

words.meaning: n.物,东西;事,事情;所有物;局面,情况
